math.description: Daga matakin farko zuwa na gaba, ka ƙware wajen tunanin lissafi mai amfani da warware matsalolin rayuwa ta gaske ta hanyar ƙalubale masu daɗi.

english.description: Fiye da shirin jarrabawa—ka koyi Turanci mai amfani don tattaunawar yau da kullum, ci gaban sana'a, kasuwanci, da tafiye-tafiye a duniya ta gajerun ƙalubale.

korean.description: Daga haruffan Hangul zuwa Koriyanci na kasuwanci, ka buɗe sababbin dama da alaƙa ta darussa da aka bayyana da harshen haihuwarka.

life.tagline: Bayanan rayuwa da ke taimakon rayuwarka
life.description: Bayanan rayuwa da ke taimakon rayuwarka

physics.description: Ayyukan binciken fisiks na aikace don fahimtar ka'idojin makanikai, wutar lantarki da makamashi.

chemistry.description: Ayyukan binciken kemistri na aikace don fahimtar tsarin sinadarai, martani da kemistri a rayuwar yau da kullum.
